title: Mugamoodi
desc: In order to impress Shakti, Bruce Lee wears a superhero costume and performs martial arts techniques. However, he gets involved in a police chase and helps the officers seize the offenders.
Visiting his school fills a travel photographer with nostalgia before a reunion unexpectedly reunites him with his childhood sweetheart.

title: Massu Engira Masilamani
desc: Massu, a con artist, discovers that he can communicate with the dead. When he learns about the truth behind his parents' murders from a prisoner, he decides to take revenge.

title: A1
desc: Divya longs to wed a rebel from another caste and meets Saravanan, who seems perfect. Her plans falter when she learns he isn't the person he claims to be.

title: Mr. Local
desc: Manohar constantly finds himself in a tussle with Keerthana, an egoistical woman, but eventually falls in love with her. However, she is far from believing he is good enough for her.
